decisions.reason: As a near-core cooler in a growing and investing machinery firm, it is likely to be retained while management compares its now somewhat clearer results with aspiration levels rather than exiting quickly.

This condenser still fits the established portfolio, but after another year the firm would scrutinize it more closely against aspirations and nearby alternatives, raising discontinuation risk somewhat without yet making exit most likely.

Because it overlaps with another new condenser, this product faces the highest review pressure if its performance falls short of aspiration, though boundedly rational management would still more likely keep it pending stronger evidence.

The tube liner builds on repair and service capabilities that support lifecycle revenues, so even modest standalone performance would usually justify keeping it unless results clearly disappoint relative to aspirations.

A customized air-cooler line matches the firm's solution-oriented business model and engineering strengths, making withdrawal unlikely while the firm has slack and can learn across several models and customer applications.

These repair inserts complement the aftermarket business and use existing technical knowledge, so management would typically retain them unless demand remains persistently below aspiration and resources are needed elsewhere.
